text:
maria: kicking off a config-only rollout now — target: reduce batch_window from 30ms -> 20ms, tighten per-route timeout 5s -> 4s, and prefer the cheap-variant on tail to lower unit cost. canary pinned to v2.2-config. deploy-bot will handle canary traffic.

deploy-bot: deploy started for config v2.2-config (config-only) — canary 10% -> 1 node us-west-2. tracking: rollout_id=cfg-1809993333.

samir: quick q — what's the rollback criteria if tail p95/99 spikes?

maria: rollback plan: immediate revert to v2.1-config and toggle routing back to balanced. manual rollback button + auto-abort if p99 > 1.5s for 5m or error-rate increases > 0.5% absolute.

jin: heads-up — earlier we saw a short egress throttling blip in us-west yesterday; watch kube pod restart counts and egress error logs.

olivia: I'll watch dashboards (per-route p50/p95/p99, batch fill rate, cache hit ratio). alerting runbook set: page if p99 > 1.2s or error-rate > 0.3%.

deploy-bot: canary finished warmup. metrics baseline capture started. canary: 10% traffic now.

maria: paste of the config we pushed: 
```json
{
  "routing_policy": "prefer-cheap-variant",
  "batch_window_ms": 20,
  "route_timeout_ms": 4000,
  "canary_percent": 10,
  "pin_version": "v2.2-config"
}
```

samir: minor nit — tests showed 4s ok for median flows but tail sometimes needs 4.5s for long-context reranking. if we see p99 grow, we should consider 4.5s.

maria: noted, we'll keep 4s for now to reduce pile-up; rollback threshold is conservative.

oncall-bot: canary metrics update: p50=120ms, p95=310ms, p99=730ms, error-rate=0.02%.

olivia: saw p99 touching 1.1s for one minute on a single route (reranker). not huge but watching.

samir: propose a short mitigation plan: if that route's p99 > 1.5s we pin that route to balanced-routing (override) and keep global config.

maria: agreed. policy: per-route override allowed during canary window. samir, can you prepare the override flag?

samir: done — flag name: routing.override.reranker=balanced. ready to flip if needed.

deploy-bot: scheduled next rollout step: increase to 50% in 20 minutes unless rollback triggered.

maria: putting the release note stub here for post-rollout: "Config-only: reduce batch_window to 20ms, tighten timeouts to 4s, route preference change to cheaper variants, canary pinned v2.2-config; rollback policy: revert to v2.1-config or per-route override if tail latency breaches thresholds."

olivia: +1 — will capture graphs and annotate any anomaly windows.

maria: decision: keep rolling unless p99 crosses 1.5s for >5m or error-rate >0.5%. otherwise proceed to 50% after 20m. I'll post final notes and the changelog link when done.

samir: :thumbsup: good call.

deploy-bot: next step scheduled at 1809993453 (20m). will post updates in thread.

maria: thanks everyone — monitoring active, oncall ready.
